candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that resets rewardsForA[recipient] to 0 before the external call.
Move the rewardsForA[recipient] = 0 reset to after the external call, creating a reentrancy vulnerability observable through state difference.
Replace the nonReentrant guard with a trivially true check, disabling reentrancy protection.
Remove the lock reset at the end of the modifier, causing permanent lock after first use.
Remove the check `require(!claimedBonus[recipient])` so the function can be called multiple times.
Comment out `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` so the function can be called multiple times.
Delete `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` so the function can be called multiple times.
Move `claimedBonus[recipient] = true;` before `withdrawReward(recipient);`, causing reentrancy state to be set early and potentially changing the reentrancy outcome.
